Name: Amazon Echo Dot Smart Speaker With Alexa - Black
Natural: Echo Dot Is A Hands-Free, Voice-Controlled Device With A Small Built-In Speaker-it Can Also Connect To Your Speakers Or Headphones Over Bluetooth Or Through A 3.5 Mm Audio Cable To Deliver Stereo Sound To The Speakers You Choose. Dot Connects To The Alexa Voice Service To Play Music, Make Calls, Send And Receive Messages, Provide Information, News, Sports Scores, Weather, And More-instantly. Echo Dot Can Hear You From Across The Room, Even While Music Is Playing. When You Want To Use Echo Dot, Just Say The Wake Word Alexa. With Its Built-In Speaker, You Can Place Dot In The Bedroom And Use It As A Smart Alarm Clock That Can Also Turn Off Your Lights. Or Use Dot In The Kitchen To Easily Set Timers. Echo Dot Can Also Directly Connect To Speakers Using A 3.5 Mm Stereo Cable, Bluetooth, Or Wi-Fi For Compatible Wireless Speakers To Add Voice Control To Your Home Stereo System. With Echo Dot, You Can Talk To Almost Anyone Hands-Free. Use The Drop In Feature When You Want To Connect.
